title: pb_int64_mod
description: `pb_int64_mod` parses a decimal-integer symbol, or truncates a float to int64, then computes its mathematical modulus N and outputs a float in the range [0, N). Negative inputs wrap correctly (for example, −1 mod 86400 produces 86399); N must be an integer from 1 to 2^24 and defaults to 86400.
